sections.title: 确切争点与有限范围
sections.text: 独立反证接受源trace真实：进入遗忘画面后，图标读取过期FURFROU形态可在BACK之前提交；随后确认放弃只保持学习招式结果。争点是当前完整WP30:242是否承诺任意Pokemon字段全局冻结。结合whole WP30、whole WP21及WP15/WP66A明确显示例外，局部学习提交解释成立。本counter不建议新增required或optional，不改正式；root独占最终分类。

sections.title: 完整输入、真实阅读与未接范围
sections.text: 完整8164B观察全部8节、32733B证据全部317行以及1995B强制范围伴件逐字段实际收到。本人不继承proposer的wholeFULL信用；原17完整单位+FURFROU注册全文实际读并逐段核固定Git，另读完整MultipleForms模块/HandlerHashSymbol/Species子类。whole WP30 1–286、whole WP21 1–327实际读；WP21中段外层截断后260–327单独补足。WP15读1–107，采用完整§4.1；WP66A读1–15及155–245，采用完整指定上下文；GR27及相邻行实际读。不声称whole WP15/WP66A、所有绘制/消息/资源/默认数据/外部事件或历史全量阅读。伴件正确保留proposer旧07:26真实FULL，当前1–271另补272–286，不撤旧FULL、不算新行为finding。

sections.title: 独立源到调用者、接收者及当前正式推导

complete_facts.meaning: Generic learning resolves target ID, rejects nil/egg (unless debug)/Shadow and already-known cases, then adds directly below MAX_MOVES. Full-slot positive first confirmation invokes pbForgetMove on the same Pokemon. Initial negative first confirmation never enters this ForgetScene chain. No default FURFROU natural-learning or demo/API reachability claim is needed or made.

The singleton party contains the original Pokemon reference. StartForgetScreen calls StartForgetScene before ChooseMoveToForget; scene constructs PokemonIconSprite for that object; initialize calls its pokemon setter. Evaluating icon_filename_from_pokemon arguments reads pkmn.form before constructing the icon AnimatedBitmap and before any BACK input. Resource/scene success is a premise for later normal cancellation, not a condition for the earlier argument-side commit.

For forced_form=nil and outside battle/storage, form calls registered getForm, and a truthy different result is submitted through form=. FURFROU missing timestamp or current seconds strictly greater than timestamp+432000 yields 0. From stored1 this writes stored0, clears ability cache, calls onSetForm (time_form_set=nil), recalculates stats and conditionally registers player dex. There is no equality short-circuit in explicit form=; dynamic getter itself checks different result. Recalculation and dex lookup can read further derived/cache state. No numeric stat change or final cache-nil guarantee is inferred.

With normal four valid old moves/first render and dependencies, BACK returns -1, the forget screen ends, and Give-up=Yes returns false without reaching the slot replacement or machine happiness writer. No captured form snapshot, inverse setter or model rollback appears in this complete chain. Four old move objects/IDs/PP/PP-up values remain unchanged by this FURFROU dynamic form path, while prior stored form/timestamp/cache/recalculation/dex prefixes can persist. Returning false does not undo them.

The positive old-slot result path constructs a fresh Pokemon::Move and assigns that single slot before later messages/happiness. by_machine plus keep-old-PP condition optionally clamps new PP. The local replacement atomic step means one fresh move state rather than half-replacing its ID/PP; the complete method contains no global transaction across rendering, messages, form getters or external callbacks. Later failures retain earlier reached writes.

WP30 purpose/scope and section6 define learning/replacement result and explicitly refer to WP21/summary UI; section9 line242 couples unchanged with single-slot+PP replacement. WP21 section3.4 already explicitly describes the exact FURFROU t+432001 individual-icon/summary commit, guards and no resource rollback; section4.2 separately disallows interpreting rejected learning as rolling back prior form changes. WP15 section4.1 applies dynamic form before icon matching. WP66A section6.5/7 defines BACK then give-up and section8 explicitly says selection returns cannot guarantee side-effect-free display. These are positive current-contract qualifications, not an absent-example excuse.

sections.text: 普通完整调用链并未克隆个体。形态提交与学习动作写入是两个领域步骤。当前正式已经给出每个必要跳转的组合规则，不能把WP30边界行从它显式引用的Summary/形态合同中孤立读成全对象事务。

vectors.premise: 合法非蛋非Shadow FURFROU，stored1，forcednil，非战斗/非仓库，time=t整数；4个合法已知招，新招已登记且未知；此前无触发回退的读取；正常字体/数据/资源/回调到输入与收尾。首次有关form读取时now.to_i=t+432001。
vectors.actions: 首次询问Yes -> ForgetScene BACK -> Give-up Yes
vectors.static_expected: stored0、时间清空及提交prefix；学招false，四旧招/PP不由本路径替换；不保证每个数值必变或图鉴每字段必新增。
不进入这个ForgetScene/icon读取链；学习false且无该链引入的动态形态提交。不能推广为任何消息/插件均纯读。
getForm不返回回退值；该读取不提交0。时间可在交互中前进，若后继读取越界须重新按当时值判断，非整场冻结。
普通form不执行这次getForm提交；forced0直接读0但保留stored1/t。

vectors.static_expected: 进入单槽fresh Move替换；普通新PP满，by_machine且配置开才旧PP夹限。图标已完成的形态prefix不因后来学招成功而取消。

sections.title: 取消、失败与部分提交
sections.text: 初次No和进入画面后BACK再Give-up是不同路径。后者的-1只是选槽结果，不是回滚令牌。给定FURFROU handler不改招式，因此学习分支不新增/替换且旧招PP保持；它确能改变form/time/cache/recalculated/dex状态。若form=的handler、calc_stats或dex中途失败，已经执行的写入仍是前缀，后继icon/输入/false未必到达。若新Move构造失败，赋槽尚未发生；若赋槽后消息失败，新槽已在。这里均未运行，不把工具exit0当游戏执行。

sections.title: 最强反方与范围建议
sections.strongest_required_argument: “个体与招式集不变（无部分提交）”字面覆盖form/time，而FURFROU动态提交是同一次正常UI调用内部发生，因此无须缺陷宿主或插件即可反驳全对象冻结；WP30 line242读者可能自然理解更广。
sections.counter: 承认字面风险与真实trace；完整合同的学习标题、前后句单槽/PP原子说明、§6.2对WP21的显式引用、§6.3对Summary的实际交互说明，以及WP21/15/66已明写的同一个体icon/summary先动态提交与不据取消返回推纯读，共同限定该句为学习提交域。尤其WP66A§8直接禁止以选择返回值承诺无副作用，WP21给出的正是FURFROU整数秒普通向量，非泛泛“可能插件有副作用”。全对象冻结解释会同时否定这些当前正条款，局部域解释可以无冲突实现全部合同。新增这一组合向量会有帮助，但完整合同未遗漏必要规则，不能仅因可写更明确就强制改稿。
sections.recommendation: NO_REQUIRED_BOUNDED_SCOPE；无强制新fixture/改字，optional也不自动计。仅在root选择编辑澄清时，可将“个体与招式集不变”限为“本次学习不新增/替换招式及PP；显示读取沿WP21”，保持既有规则，不将真实动态提交描述成不存在。
